  utf8_sha256:"d596abf3…", utf8_bytes:121}}` — columns are ZERO-based UTF-16

  `ev_f2526427…` reports `matched_generated_position {line:1, column:80}` →

  segment of a line inherits the nearest earlier mapping rather than an

  pty records (`data:"1\r\n2\r\n3\r\n4\r\n5\r\n"` vs `"1\r\n2\r\n3\r\n"`,
  CRLF — ONLCR), `exit:"unchanged"`, `filesystem:"unknown"` and

  divergence block is the two `settlement` objects, `elapsed_ms:67` vs `66`;

  `raw_trace` pointing at `frames[0]`, right `fail` with diagnostic

  `ev_43a7ea91…` verdict **`equivalent`** (both sides pass `five-lines`) —
  the declared language asserts exactly the behavioral identity the default
  exit dimension noise hides. Two lessons from authoring the spec: (i) the

## Summary

Queue-A rows 22 and 24 are discharged on real host artifacts. Row 22: the
chain runs end-to-end — a connect-mode `capture-browser-scenario` run with
`network.response_body:true` retains the page's JS as decoded response
bodies; `export-web-scripts` publishes exactly the retained script bytes
byte-faithfully (HTML excluded) under an origin-hash layout with a digest-
and evidence-linked manifest; `trace-web-module-imports` resolves main.js's
static import to the captured lib.js via a caller-supplied chromium 152
running only a REA resolver stub — a leg whose `REA_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE` gate
refuses typed without env, is invisible in the 18-op capability matrix, and
is satisfied zero-provisioning by the host's own chromium; and
`trace-web-source-location` maps generated positions through a
caller-selected map on node (`jridgewell-trace-mapping`), verifying original
positions against embedded `sourcesContent` (`verified-in-embedded-text`),
reporting zero-based UTF-16 columns, honestly keeping
`source_authenticity`/`execution` unknown, and — probed — falling back
across lines to the greatest ≤ segment rather than ever answering `unmapped`.
Chain reproducibility proven byte-identical on both trace legs. Row 24:
`capture-process` runs scripted pty scenarios (`seq`, `cat` with a timed
input event and an idle-timeout SIGKILL settlement) under a fourth authority
grade, `controlled-replay`/`observed`; `compare-process-captures` diffs raw
pty bytes per dimension but keys its `exit` dimension on wall-clock
settlement — same-scenario re-captures grade `changed` on 67-vs-66 ms and
envelope ids are timing-parameterized by design — while the optional
finite-trace `traceSpec` restores a timing-insensitive verdict (`equivalent`
for the A/A2 re-capture, `different` for A/B) from a strict, exactly-payload
event language. The census's self-provisionable premise holds for both rows;
the only refinement is leg 2's env-name gate (recorded both as refusal and
success). With r11-02's line 189, the Queue-A table (lines 165–189) is fully
drained.
